fields.description: The doctype this workflow governs. One workflow per approvable doctype.
fields.label: Workflow For

fields.description: Fieldname on the governed doctype holding its Geo Node anchor. ACC-02: a Link, required at creation, never free text.
fields.label: Geo Node Field

fields.description: Fieldname identifying the applicant, used by the re-application cooldown. Empty falls back to the document's owner.
fields.label: Applicant Field

fields.description: Whether an applicant may withdraw while the application is still open.
fields.label: Allow Withdrawal

fields.description: Days a rejected applicant must wait before applying again. 0 means no cooldown.
fields.label: Re-application Cooldown (Days)

fields.description: Days of inactivity after which an open application expires. 0 means applications never expire.
fields.label: Application Expiry (Days)

fields.description: ACC-03. Which levels of the hierarchy an application of this type may be anchored at. A society that deploys at county level and one that deploys at ward level configure this differently and change no code.
fields.label: Anchor Levels

fields.description: Empty means any active level is acceptable.
fields.label: Allowed Anchor Levels

fields.description: The stages of In Review, in sequence. At least one must be able to reject, or an application could only ever be approved.
fields.label: Stages
